mechanism: Rasagiline (irreversible MAOI) combined with prochlorperazine (antipsychotic with sympathomimetic potential) increases risk of hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome via monoamine potentiation.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if prochlorperazine is necessary for nausea/vomiting, use alternative antipsychotic with minimal sympathomimetic activity and monitor blood pressure closely.
